orders.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL 
A.O. No. 474 of 2012.
The Oriental Insurance Company Limited. 
… Appellant. 
Vs. 
Chandi Prasad Bahuguna and others. 1. 
…Respondents. 
Mr.V.K.Kohli, Senior Advocate with Ms. Vandana Singh, Advocate, learned counsel for the 
appellant. 
Date September 18, 2012. 
Hon’ble B.S.Verma, J. (Oral)
(Stay Application No.9925 of 2012) 
 Heard learned counsel for the appellant. 
 Admit the appeal. 
 Issue notice of appeal to the respondents. 
 Summon the lower court record. 
 List after the lower court record is received and service is 
effected upon the respondents. 
 Execution of the impugned award dated 19-6-2012, 
passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/ District Judge Pauri 
Garhwal (for short the Tribunal) in Motor Accident Claim Petition No. 
99 of 2007, Chandi Prasad Bahuguna and others Vs. Pawan Singh 
Chauhan and others, shall remain stayed, provided the appellant￾Insurance Company deposits the entire awarded amount before the 
Tribunal after adjusting statutory amount deposited in appeal within a 
period of two months from today. (Stay application is disposed of.) 
 
 
(B.S.Verma,J.) 
RCP

orders.text:
ACLMA No. 2381 of 2013
In
AO No. 474 of 2012
 
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Shri I.P.Kohli, Advocate, present for the
appellant.
Shri R.K.S. Verma, Advocate, holding brief
of Shri H.M. Bhatia, Advocate, present for the
claimants/respondent nos. 1 to 3.
 This is Money Withdrawal Application
No. 2381 of 2013 for release of the amount
deposited by the appellant before the Motor
Accident Claims Tribunal/District Judge Pauri
Garhwal, in Motor Accident Claim Petition No.
99 of 2007.
Heard.
 Money Withdrawal Application is
disposed of with the direction that 50 % of the
deposited amount by the appellant before the
Tribunal be released in favour of the claimants.
Rest be deposited under Fixed Deposit Scheme
by the Tribunal. 
List the appeal for final hearing in due
course. 
 
(P.C.Pant,J.)
 
12-04-2013
